messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Pager: detected billing-metering mismatch in eu1. Token count divergence >12% between usage-collector and billing-aggregator. Overage flags firing for a subset of customers. Severity: P1. https://ops.internal/incidents/1758884444

alex: picking up oncall — acknowledging. triage channel set to #incidents.

jamie: I'm seeing consumer lag on collector-eu1-02, Kafka lag ~120k. spike started ~2h ago.

alex: possible coupling. maria, can you check billing-aggregator logs for commit-window errors? try `kubectl logs -n billing aggregator-0 | grep commit`

maria: on it. quick log snippet: `ERROR commit-window: expected 2024-09-01T12:00, saw 2024-09-01T11:58` — aggregator processed an older watermark, looks like a watermark regression.

isha: we rolled out a consumer-group config yesterday (rollout r-2024-09-01-agg-cg). could be related — consumer group id changed and some consumers restarted.

jamie: consumer lag timeline: spike at ~1758879000. I can tail the group: `kafka-consumer-groups --describe --group billing-eu1`

alex: Customer impact check: small cohort (~120 customers) got overage emails. billing/ops looped in. @emily-support any support tickets?

emily-support: two customers opened tickets (ACME, BetaApps) reporting unexpected overage emails. escalated to enterprise success. telling them: "we're on it, investigating a telemetry mismatch"

maria: root cause found: aggregator commit-loop retained old offset mapping after the config change, causing overlapping windows and double-counting on restart. patch in progress (PR #4287).

isha: careful — a plain restart of aggregator will replay tokens and could double the counts further. we need an offset reconciliation plan before deploy.

alex: plan: 1) pause emitter for eu1 (jamie) to stop new tokens, 2) run dedupe/reconcile job for recent 2h window (maria), 3) roll forward config with offset-fix and canary (isha), 4) notify customers (emily).

jamie: pausing emitter now: `curl -X POST http://emit-control/eu1/pause` -> 200 OK. emitter paused.

maria: starting dedupe dry-run: `python tools/reconcile_tokens.py --start 1758872000 --end 1758884444 --mode dryrun` — dry run looks correct, now applying.

maria: apply complete — dedupe removed ~1.8M duplicate tokens across the affected windows. preparing patch build and canary.

isha: canary rolling to aggregator-1. watching commit success and latency. no spike in errors observed so far.

alex: :thumbsup: Emily, please send interim notice to affected customers: "We identified a telemetry duplication bug; we've paused emission and are deduping. No charge adjustments needed now; final reconciliation and credits will be confirmed by EOD."

emily-support: sent to ACME, BetaApps and the Affected-Customers list. ticket updates attached.

alex: handoff: my shift ends in ~30m — @maria will be primary for the next 4h. @jamie keep infra watch, @isha own the config rollout. I'll stay reachable if needed.

maria: ack. telemetry disparity converging to <0.5% after dedupe + canary. creating follow-up ticket for reconciliation + billing credits.

IncidentBot: Incident status updated -> mitigated. Post-incident actions: postmortem assigned to billing/telemetry. https://ops.internal/postmortems/1758884444
